playstyle.identity: Xerath is a long-range artillery mage who bombards enemies from extreme distance. His ultimate can snipe enemies across the map.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: autos restore mana. Q charges to extend range. W creates a zone that slows and damages. E stuns (longer range = longer stun). R locks in place and fires 3-5 long-range shots. Poke with Q-W, E for peel, R to snipe from afar.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Xerath spikes with mana and ability haste. Luden's scales his poke. He's strong at siege and poking safely.

passive.name: Mana Surge
passive.details: Xerath's auto attacks periodically restore mana.

abilities.name: Arcanopulse
abilities.summary: Charge and release a long-range beam.
abilities.details: Xerath charges up, increasing range. On release, he fires a beam that damages all enemies in a line.

abilities.name: Eye of Destruction
abilities.summary: Call down a blast that slows and damages, more in center.
abilities.details: Xerath calls down a blast at a location, dealing damage and slowing. Enemies in the center take more damage and are slowed more.

abilities.name: Shocking Orb
abilities.summary: Fire an orb that stuns; longer travel = longer stun.
abilities.details: Xerath fires an orb that stuns the first enemy hit. The stun duration increases based on travel distance.

abilities.name: Rite of the Arcane
abilities.summary: Root yourself and fire 3-5 long-range shots.
abilities.details: Xerath roots himself in place and fires a barrage of shots at extreme range, each dealing damage on impact.
